abstract: Maintains international port clearance and maritime facility access records
system_message:
You are the Port logistics and security manager (SEC), responsible for maintaining international port clearance, maritime facility access records, and staging berth draft compatibility evaluations across regional emergency facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Staging berth draft compatibility（BERTH）
information_points.content:
SEC-BERTH-0AK：According to the vessel stability booklet for the Pacific Resolute in fully provisioned salvage configuration, the maximum summer operating draft is 6.5 m.
SEC-BERTH-LLM：For the Baltic Endeavour, stability documentation in fully provisioned salvage configuration records a maximum summer operating draft of 7.8 m.
SEC-BERTH-X6S：The vessel stability booklet for the Oceanic Vanguard indicates a maximum summer operating draft of 8.5 m in its fully provisioned salvage configuration.

information_points.title: Maintains international port clearance and maritime facility access records（PORT）
information_points.content:
SEC-PORT-K0T：According to regional emergency staging port filings, harbor access records confirm that port security pre-authorization granted is true for the Baltic Endeavour.
SEC-PORT-BYG：Harbor master emergency access filings across regional emergency staging ports indicate that port security pre-authorization granted is false for the Oceanic Vanguard, as pre-screened priority docking and staging clearance is not granted.
SEC-PORT-RCO：For the Pacific Resolute, harbor master emergency access filings across regional emergency staging ports verify that port security pre-authorization granted is true, confirming pre-screened security clearance for priority docking and equipment staging.
